g.text: LANDING ZONE · HUB AND SPOKE · DEDICATED INTERCONNECT 99.99%
One transit hub, one Shared VPC per environment, every path between them named. Prod and nonprod never peer.

Two metros land four VLAN attachments on two Cloud Routers in the transit hub. Spokes attach through Network Connectivity Center. Tiers sit in their own subnets with no public IPs; ingress enters through one load balancer with
Cloud Armor and IAP in front.
Transit hub VPC · NCC hub · one network, two regions
BGP timers from the Cloud Router
same private ASN as Region A
Hub advertises the Google VIP ranges named on the Private Google Access doc · Cloud DNS forwarding source range from the forwarding-
private IP only · no route from web
backup path, DNS forwarding and region failover
Illustrative topology · hop facts are placeholders, not looked-up values
